subject: Pilot readiness: decision criteria, acceptance tests, and close playbook
messages:
From: Evan Simmons <evan.simmons@acmehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot scope and timeline (initial ask)

Soojin — thanks for the demo yesterday. Priya and I discussed internally and we want to move forward with a short pilot to validate Redwood in our triage workflow. Before we kick off we need a short mutual action plan that explicitly states success criteria and the acceptance tests we'll run.

Top-level asks from our side: 
- Clear pass/fail criteria for model quality on our clinical intent set (we'll provide ~500 labeled samples)
- Performance envelope: 90th percentile latency target for 512-token requests
- Data handling: confirmation of no PII retention and audit logs for the pilot window
- Timeline: a ~2-week run with a decision at the end for expansion

Can you send a short MAP with owners, exit gates, and a target close date? Also will need a copy of any test plan and sample test cases.

Thanks,
Evan
Director of Product
Acme Health

---
Attachment: none

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Evan Simmons <evan.simmons@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-02T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot scope and timeline (initial ask)

Evan — great to hear you want to proceed. I've attached a first-pass MAP draft and a conservative test-case CSV so we can align quickly. High level summary below, followed by proposed owners and milestones.

Summary of proposed success criteria (pilot-level):
- Quality: >= 85% intent classification accuracy on your 500 labeled clinical samples (measure: micro-F1)
- Safety: zero critical PII leaks in a randomized 200-sample audit; any PII flag triggers immediate rollback
- Latency: 90th percentile <= 250ms for 512-token requests under expected concurrency (30 RPS)
- Stability: no >5% error rate over a 48-hour continuous load window

Exit gates (what must be true to consider pilot successful):
1) All checklist items above met
2) Security questionnaire items flagged by Acme closed or documented plan with owners
3) Integration smoke test passes end-to-end with production-ish dataset

Owners and timeline (2-week pilot):
- Redwood PM / AM (owner): Soojin Lee — overall coordination, MAP owner
- Sales (commercial lead): Rishi Malhotra — commercial signoff and close timeline
- Solutions engineer (SWE + metrics): Marissa Cole — test design, metrics collection, runbook
- Customer engineering lead: Priya Sharma — dataset, test inputs, sandbox access

Proposed target decision date: 2026-04-16 (final go/no-go) and target close by 2026-05-01 if pilot validates.

Next steps: 
- Evan/Priya: confirm the 500-sample set and share access to the sandbox by Monday (2026-04-05)
- Marissa: review the attached test cases and suggest additions by 2026-04-04
- Rishi/So ojin: update commercial terms to reflect 2-week pilot pricing (I will share a quote)

I attached: redwood-map-draft-v1.pdf (MAP draft) and acme-pilot-testcases.csv (sample test cases). Let me know if you want a short call tomorrow to walk the MAP.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0157

---
Attachments: redwood-map-draft-v1.pdf, acme-pilot-testcases.csv

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Simmons <evan.simmons@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-03T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot scope and timeline (initial ask)

Thanks Soojin — the summary is helpful. A couple of clarifications from our security/privacy team that will also be part of exit gates: 
- We need a clear statement on ephemeral KV cache: how long session context is retained and where (in-memory vs persisted)
- A short audit log export demonstrating call-level metadata (no model outputs) for the pilot window

On quality: the 85% micro-F1 is a good starting point; we'll run an inter-rater sample to make sure labels are comparable. If you can add a short acceptance test that flags hallucination rates (e.g., factual hallucination on a 100-sample gold set <8%), that would be ideal.

We can share the 500-sample set by COB Monday. Can you confirm the sandbox endpoint and credentials pattern?

Best,
Priya
Lead, Data & Models
Acme Health

---
Attachment: none

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-04T08:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot scope and timeline (initial ask)

Priya — thanks, that's useful. Quick answers: 
- KV cache: by default we use in-memory ephemeral KV cache with TTL of the request session; we will not persist session context to disk for this pilot. I'll have Marissa add an explicit checklist item that verifies no write-to-disk of session context in the sandbox.
- Audit logs: we can provide a filtered audit export with call-level metadata (timestamp, request id, model id, latency) and exclude model outputs. We'll add that as a required artifact for the exit gate.
- Hallucination check: we'll include the 100-sample factuality subset and measure a simple factuality rate (samples flagged by your SME). Proposed threshold: <8% hallucination.

Marissa — can you please: 
1) Review the attached testcases and add a small set of factuality checks (100 samples)
2) Add steps to validate no PII writes and how we'll verify audit logs
3) Prepare the sandbox endpoint details and share credentials pattern (temporary API key)

Rishi — can you draft the short commercial note reflecting the pilot price and potential conversion credits if we proceed to Dedicated? We want to avoid surprises at decision day.

I'll plan a 30-minute sync on Monday (2026-04-05) after you share the sample set.

Thanks,
Soojin

---
Attachment: none

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-06T15:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot scope and timeline (initial ask)

All — added a couple of commercial and close-playbook items. See brief notes below and updated attachments in Drive. I'll own the commercial decision path and handoff.

Commercial playbook (short):
- Pilot pricing: 2-week pilot flat fee USD 12,500 (includes support and monitoring dashboard access)
- Conversion credit: 50% of pilot fee credited against first month of Dedicated if contract executed within 30 days of successful pilot
- Decision workflow: 
  - Day 0-14: Pilot run (metrics collection, security checklist, smoke tests)
  - Decision day (2026-04-16): Joint scorecard review (technical and commercial)
  - Decision outcomes: go -> draft contract & SOW; pause -> remediation plan and 2-week extension; stop -> closure notes and learnings

Acceptance test quick checklist (for scoreboard):
- Quality: micro-F1 >= 85% on 500-sample set
- Factuality: hallucination rate < 8% on 100-sample set
- Latency: P90 <= 250ms under 30 RPS
- Stability: error rate < 5% over 48h
- Security: audit export provided + no PII persisted

Owners: Soojin (MAP owner), Marissa (test run and metrics), Connor (ops readiness: TLS, KMS pattern), Rishi (commercial).

I'll upload an updated MAP to the shared Drive and set a calendar invite for the 2026-04-16 scorecard review.

Thanks,
Rishi
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
